resources.string: Android has not linked this watch to OpenWatch. Without the link, OpenWatch cannot record workouts that another app starts on the watch.

The watch is not paired with this phone. Open Bluetooth settings and pair it; make the watch discoverable from its own Bluetooth settings first.

The OpenWatch app on the watch records your heart rate and what a sleep estimate needs, and keeps a week of it. Sync copies the new heart rate into Health Connect and writes one estimated sleep session per night.
The watch keeps these settings itself. Read them to change them here.
